qe: What does the story of 'Sitaram Sipahi' depict during the 1857 revolt era?
qh: 1857 के विद्रोह के दौरान 'सीताराम सिपाही' की कहानी क्या दर्शाती है?
e: Sitaram Pande ke memoirs 'From Sepoy to Subedar' se pata chalta hai ki us time samundar paar (kala pani) jaane wale sipahiyon ko unka samaj dharam-bhrasht maan kar social boycott kar deta tha. Prashn ka saar yah hai ki 1857 ke vidroh ke dauran 'sitaram sipahi' ki kahani kya darshati hai? In tathyon ke chalte Fear of social boycott hi sahi hai. Baaki vikalp - Gaining wealth, Joy of foreign travel, Bravery of the British - is vishay se mel nahi khaate. Isliye in vikalpon ko chhod dena chahiye. Yah sab dekhkar sahi uttar Fear of social boycott baithta hai. Exam point: Fear of social boycott - yahi is prashn ki mukhya baat hai.

qe: In the British squad that blew up Kashmiri Gate, where were most of the soldiers from?
qh: कश्मीरी गेट को उड़ाने वाले ब्रिटिश दस्ते में अधिकांश सैनिक कहाँ के थे?
e: Delhi par wapas control karne ke dauran Kashmiri Gate todne wale British squad me maximum soldiers Indian hi the, jo Punjab, Agra aur Awadh regions se recruit kiye gaye the. Is prashn mein poochha gaya hai ki kashmiri get ko udane vale british daste mein adhikansh sainik kahan ke the? Isi tathya par Punjab, Agra, and Awadh tika hua hai. Galti Madras, England, France chunne se hoti hai kyunki inka is tathya se talmel nahi hai. Isliye in vikalpon ko chhod dena chahiye. Isi wajah se Punjab, Agra, and Awadh sahi hai. Exam point: Punjab, Agra, and Awadh - is tathya ko aankdon ke saath yaad rakhein.

qe: From which place did the 1857 revolt formally begin?
qh: 1857 का विद्रोह औपचारिक रूप से किस स्थान से शुरू हुआ था?
e: 1857 ka formal rebellion 10 May 1857 ko Meerut cantonment se 3rd Native Cavalry ke sipahiyon dwara shuru kiya gaya tha. Prashn yah batata hai ki 1857 ka vidroh aupacharik rup se kis sthan se shuru hua tha? Isi karan se Meerut sahi uttar hai. Kanpur, Delhi, Barrackpore anya kaal, vyakti ya ghatna se jude hain. Yah vikalp anya sandarbh se aa jaate hain. Aakhir mein sahi pehchan Meerut hi milti hai. Exam point: Meerut - isse jude tathya yaad rakhein.

qe: When did the soldiers from Meerut reach Delhi after crossing the Yamuna river?
qh: मेरठ के सिपाही यमुना नदी पार करके दिल्ली कब पहुँचे?
e: Meerut me mutiny ke baad sipahi raat bhar march karke agle hi din 11 May 1857 ki subah Yamuna par boat bridge cross karke Red Fort Delhi pahunche the. Prashn yah saaf karna chahta hai ki merath ke sipahi yamuna nadi par karake dilli kab pahunche? Isi karan se 11th May 1857 sahi uttar hai. Galti 12th May 1857, 15th May 1857, 10th May 1857 chunne se hoti hai kyunki inka is tathya se talmel nahi hai. Inka is tathya se koi talmel nahi hai. Aakhir mein sahi pehchan 11th May 1857 hi milti hai. Exam point: 11th May 1857 - yah tathya bhoolna nahi chahiye.

qe: Who was the Governor-General of India during the 1857 revolt?
qh: 1857 के विद्रोह के समय भारत का गवर्नर जनरल कौन था?
e: Revolt ke time Lord Canning India ke Governor-General the, jo 1858 ke Act ke baad India ke pehle Viceroy bane. Is prashn ka seedha matlab yah hai ki 1857 ke vidroh ke samay bharat ka gavarnar janaral kaun tha? Diye gaye tathya ke aadhar par Lord Canning sahi nikalta hai. Lord Ripon, Lord Wellesley, Lord Dalhousie is prashn ke vishay se door pade hain. Yah vikalp anya sandarbh se aa jaate hain. Isliye sahi uttar Lord Canning hi hai. Exam point: Lord Canning - is tathya ko aankdon ke saath yaad rakhein.

qe: Who was the monarch of Britain during the 1857 revolt?
qh: 1857 की क्रांति के समय ब्रिटेन की महारानी कौन थी?
e: 1857 rebellion ke dauran Britain par Queen Victoria ka rule tha, jinhone 1858 me East India Company se power direct Crown ke under le li. Prashn is baat par tika hai ki 1857 ki kranti ke samay briten ki maharani kaun thi? Isi aadhar par Queen Victoria chuna jaata hai. Baaki vikalp - Queen Mary, Queen Elizabeth, Queen Anne - is vishay se mel nahi khaate. Yah vikalp anya sandarbh se aa jaate hain. Isi wajah se Queen Victoria sahi hai. Exam point: Queen Victoria - ise tathya ke saath yaad rakhein.

qe: Which symbols were used by the rebels to spread the message of the 1857 revolution?
qh: विद्रोहियों ने 1857 की क्रांति के संदेश फैलाने के लिए किन प्रतीकों का उपयोग किया?
e: Gaon-gaon me secretly rebellion ka message spread karne aur solidarity dikhane ke liye Chapati (roti) aur Red Lotus ka use kiya gaya tha. Is prashn mein poochha gaya hai ki vidrohiyon ne 1857 ki kranti ke sandesh phailane ke lie kin pratikon ka upayog kiya? Isi tathya par Lotus and Chapati tika hua hai. Galti Sword and Shield, Lion and Cow, Tricolour and Charkha chunne se hoti hai kyunki inka is tathya se talmel nahi hai. Yah teeno vikalp prashn ke mool bindu se hatt jaate hain. Yah sab dekhkar sahi uttar Lotus and Chapati baithta hai. Exam point: Lotus and Chapati - yahi is prashn ki mukhya baat hai.

qe: Whom did the Meerut soldiers choose as their supreme leader upon reaching Delhi?
qh: मेरठ के सिपाहियों ने दिल्ली पहुँचकर किसे अपना मुख्य नेता चुना?
e: Sipahiyon ne Red Fort pahunch kar aakhiri Mughal badshah Bahadur Shah Zafar ko 'Shahenshah-e-Hindustan' proclaim kiya aur unhe rebellion ka supreme leader banaya. Is prashn ka mool sawaal yah hai ki merath ke sipahiyon ne dilli pahunchakar kise apana mukhy neta chuna? Isi karan se Bahadur Shah Zafar sahi uttar hai. Kunwar Singh, Nana Saheb, Tantia Tope alag khandan, kaal ya kshetra ke hain. Isliye in vikalpon ko chhod dena chahiye. Is prashn ka theek jawab Bahadur Shah Zafar hai. Exam point: Bahadur Shah Zafar - is tathya ko aankdon ke saath yaad rakhein.

qe: Which soldier of the 34th Native Infantry started the revolt in Barrackpore?
qh: बैरकपुर छावनी में 34वीं नेटिव इन्फेंट्री के किस सिपाही ने विद्रोह की शुरुआत की थी?
e: 34th Bengal Native Infantry ke sepoy Mangal Pandey ne 29 March 1857 ko Barrackpore me greased cartridges use karne se mana kiya aur British officers par attack kar diya. Sawaal is baat ka hai ki bairakapur chhavani mein 34vin netiv inpheintri ke kis sipahi ne vidroh ki shuruat ki thi? Isliye sahi nateeja Mangal Pandey nikalta hai. Rajguru, Sukhdev, Bhagat Singh in tathyon se hatt kar jaate hain. Yah vikalp anya sandarbh se aa jaate hain. Isliye sahi uttar Mangal Pandey hi hai. Exam point: Mangal Pandey - yah baat pariksha mein baar-baar poochhi jaati hai.

qe: Who led the 1857 revolt in Kanpur?
qh: कानपुर में 1857 के विद्रोह का नेतृत्व किसने किया था?
e: Kanpur me last Peshwa Baji Rao II ke adopted son Nana Saheb (Dhondu Pant) ne Tantia Tope aur Azimullah Khan ke sath milkar rebellion lead kiya. Prashn yah saaf karna chahta hai ki kanapur mein 1857 ke vidroh ka netritv kisane kiya tha? Isi karan se Nana Saheb sahi uttar hai. Baaki vikalp - Begum Hazrat Mahal, Rani Lakshmibai, Kunwar Singh - is vishay se mel nahi khaate. Yah teeno vikalp prashn ke mool bindu se hatt jaate hain. Yah sab dekhkar sahi uttar Nana Saheb baithta hai. Exam point: Nana Saheb - yahi is prashn ki mukhya baat hai.

qe: Who led the revolt in Lucknow (Awadh)?
qh: लखनऊ (अवध) में 1857 के विद्रोह का नेतृत्व किसने किया था?
e: Exiled Nawab Wajid Ali Shah ki begum, Begum Hazrat Mahal ne apne minor son Birjis Qadr ko nawab declare karke Lucknow me Britishers ke against lead kiya. Is prashn ka mool sawaal yah hai ki lakhanau (avadh) mein 1857 ke vidroh ka netritv kisane kiya tha? Isi karan se Begum Hazrat Mahal sahi uttar hai. Baaki vikalp - Maulvi Liyakat Ali, Rani Lakshmibai, Khan Bahadur Khan - is vishay se mel nahi khaate. Inka is tathya se koi talmel nahi hai. Yah sab dekhkar sahi uttar Begum Hazrat Mahal baithta hai. Exam point: Begum Hazrat Mahal - yah tathya bhoolna nahi chahiye.

qe: Which region was historically referred to as the 'Nursery of the Bengal Army'?
qh: किस क्षेत्र को 'बंगाल आर्मी की पौधशाला' कहा जाता था?
e: Bengal Army me lagbhag 75,000 se zyada soldiers akele Awadh region se aate the, isliye Awadh ko 'Nursery of the Bengal Army' kaha jata tha. Is prashn mein poochha gaya hai ki kis kshetr ko 'bangal armi ki paudhashala' kaha jata tha? Isliye sahi nateeja Awadh nikalta hai. Jhansi, Bihar, Punjab mein is tathya ka sahi rang nahi milta. Yah vikalp anya sandarbh se aa jaate hain. Yah sab dekhkar sahi uttar Awadh baithta hai. Exam point: Awadh - ise tathya ke saath yaad rakhein.

qe: Who introduced the policy of Subsidiary Alliance in India?
qh: भारत में सहायक संधि की नीति किसने शुरू की थी?
e: Governor-General Lord Wellesley ne 1798 me Subsidiary Alliance system introduce kiya tha, jiska first signatory Hyderabad ka Nizam bana tha. Is prashn ka mool sawaal yah hai ki bharat mein sahayak sandhi ki niti kisane shuru ki thi? subsidiary alliance mein desi riyasat apni raksha ke liye angrezi sena ka kharch deti thi tatha bina anumati videsh niti nahi chala sakti thi. Isi karan se Lord Wellesley sahi uttar hai. Lord Curzon, Lord Canning, Lord Dalhousie alag khandan, kaal ya kshetra ke hain. Isliye in vikalpon ko chhod dena chahiye. Isliye sahi uttar Lord Wellesley hi hai. Exam point: Lord Wellesley - ise tathya ke saath yaad rakhein.

qe: Who was the architect of the Doctrine of Lapse policy?
qh: हड़प नीति या विलय की नीति (Doctrine of Lapse) का जनक कौन था?
e: Lord Dalhousie ne Doctrine of Lapse policy use karke natural male heir na hone par Satara, Sambalpur, Nagpur aur Jhansi jaise princely states ko annex kar liya tha. Prashn is baat par tika hai ki hadap niti ya vilay ki niti (Doctrine of Lapse) ka janak kaun tha? Prashn ke sabhi tathyon ko milane par Lord Dalhousie hi sahi uttar nikalta hai. Lord Wellesley, Lord Irwin, Lord Minto is baat ki sahi jaankari nahi dete. Inka is tathya se koi talmel nahi hai. Is prashn ka theek jawab Lord Dalhousie hai. Exam point: Lord Dalhousie - isse jude tathya yaad rakhein.

qe: Which rebel leader was popularly known as 'Danka Shah'?
qh: विद्रोहियों के बीच 'डंका शाह' के नाम से कौन प्रसिद्ध थे?
e: Faizabad ke Maulvi Ahmadullah Shah jab palanquin me travel karte the toh aage drum (danka) bajta tha, isliye log unhe 'Danka Shah' kehte the. Is prashn mein poochha gaya hai ki vidrohiyon ke bich 'danka shah' ke nam se kaun prasiddh the? Yahi wajah hai ki Maulvi Ahmadullah Shah sahi hai. Maulvi Liyakat Ali, Bakht Khan, Shah Mal is baat ki sahi jaankari nahi dete. Isliye in vikalpon ko chhod dena chahiye. Aakhir mein sahi pehchan Maulvi Ahmadullah Shah hi milti hai. Exam point: Maulvi Ahmadullah Shah - isse jude tathya yaad rakhein.

qe: Which princely state was described by Lord Dalhousie as 'a cherry that will drop into our mouth one day'?
qh: लॉर्ड डलहौजी ने किस रियासत को 'एक चेरी जो एक दिन हमारे मुंह में गिरेगी' कहा था?
e: Lord Dalhousie ne 1851 me Awadh ke context me ye statement diya tha, aur aakhirkaar 1856 me use British territory me merge kar liya gaya. Is prashn ka seedha matlab yah hai ki lord dalahauji ne kis riyasat ko 'ek cheri jo ek din hamare munh mein giregi' kaha tha? Isi baat se Awadh sahi sabit hota hai. Galti Mysore, Punjab, Bengal chunne se hoti hai kyunki inka is tathya se talmel nahi hai. In vikalpon ka is prashn se seedha rishta nahi hai. Sabhi baaton ke baad Awadh hi theek uttar hai. Exam point: Awadh - yah baat pariksha mein baar-baar poochhi jaati hai.

qe: Under the British revenue system, which class was directly affected by the 'Sunset Law'?
qh: ब्रिटिश भू-राजस्व प्रणाली के तहत 'सूर्यास्त कानून' से मुख्य रूप से कौन सा वर्ग प्रभावित था?
e: Permanent Settlement ke Sunset Law ke according agar Zamindar fixed date ke sunset tak tax jama nahi karte the, toh unki zamindari public auction me bech di jaati thi. Is prashn mein yah jaanna hai ki british bhu-rajasv pranali ke tahat 'suryast kanun' se mukhy rup se kaun sa varg prabhavit tha? Yahi wajah hai ki Zamindars sahi hai. Labourers, Sepoys, Traders ko chunne par jawab galat ho jaayega. Isliye in vikalpon ko chhod dena chahiye. Ant mein sahi chunav Zamindars hi thehrta hai. Exam point: Zamindars - isse jude tathya yaad rakhein.

qe: Which British officer remarked that the Rani of Jhansi was 'the only man among the rebels'?
qh: किस अंग्रेज अधिकारी ने कहा था कि 'विद्रोहियों में झांसी की रानी एकमात्र मर्द थी'?
e: Jhansi aur Gwalior me ladne wale British commander Sir Hugh Rose ne Rani Lakshmibai ki bravery dekh kar unhe 'the best and bravest military leader' aur 'only man among the rebels' kaha tha. Is prashn mein yah jaanna hai ki kis angrej adhikari ne kaha tha ki 'vidrohiyon mein jhansi ki rani ekamatr mard thi'? Isi aadhar par Sir Hugh Rose chuna jaata hai. Colin Campbell, Major Hodson, William Taylor in tathyon se hatt kar jaate hain. Isliye in vikalpon ko chhod dena chahiye. Ant mein sahi chunav Sir Hugh Rose hi thehrta hai. Exam point: Sir Hugh Rose - ise kaal-kram mein baithakar yaad karein.

qe: Where was Mughal Emperor Bahadur Shah Zafar exiled after the suppression of the 1857 revolt?
qh: 1857 के विद्रोह के दमन के बाद बहादुर शाह जफर को कहाँ निर्वासित कर दिया गया था?
e: Humayun's Tomb se arrest hone ke baad Bahadur Shah Zafar ko family ke sath Burma ke Rangoon (ab Yangon) bhej diya gaya jahan 1862 me unki death hui. Is prashn ka mool sawaal yah hai ki 1857 ke vidroh ke daman ke bad bahadur shah japhar ko kahan nirvasit kar diya gaya tha? Isliye sahi nateeja Rangoon nikalta hai. Vikalp Sri Lanka, Andaman, London bhi is tathya ke dayre se baahar hain. In vikalpon ka is prashn se seedha rishta nahi hai. Aakhir mein sahi pehchan Rangoon hi milti hai. Exam point: Rangoon - is tathya ko aankdon ke saath yaad rakhein.

qe: What was the primary immediate religious grievance regarding the Enfield P-53 rifle cartridges?
qh: एनफील्ड राइफल के कारतूसों को लेकर मुख्य तात्कालिक धार्मिक आपत्ति क्या थी?
o: Grease made from cow and pig fat
e: Enfield rifle ke paper cartridges par cow aur pig fat ki coating ki khabar thi, jise bite karna padta tha; isne Hindu aur Muslim dono ke religious sentiments ko hurt kiya. Sawaal is baat ka hai ki enaphild raiphal ke karatuson ko lekar mukhy tatkalik dharmik apatti kya thi? Isliye antim jawab Grease made from cow and pig fat ke roop mein milta hai. Baaki vikalp - Poor manufacturing quality, Excessive weight, Defective firing range - is vishay se mel nahi khaate. Yah teeno vikalp prashn ke mool bindu se hatt jaate hain. Is prashn ka theek jawab Grease made from cow and pig fat hai. Exam point: Grease made from cow and pig fat - isse jude tathya yaad rakhein.

qe: What was a primary organizational reason for the failure of the 1857 revolt?
qh: 1857 के विद्रोह की असफलता का एक मुख्य संगठनात्मक कारण क्या था?
o: Lack of centralized leadership, coordination, and modern resources
Widespread popular opposition by common masses
e: Revolt isolated pockets me tha; isme centralized war plan, modern weaponry aur unified cohesive leadership ki kami thi jisse British army ne ise alag-alag daba diya. Prashn is baat par tika hai ki 1857 ke vidroh ki asaphalata ka ek mukhy sangathanatmak karan kya tha? Diye gaye tathya ke aadhar par Lack of centralized leadership, coordination, and modern resources hi sahi baithta hai. Total shortage of sepoys, Widespread popular opposition by common masses, Immediate withdrawal of British forces mein is tathya ka sahi rang nahi milta. Yah teeno vikalp prashn ke mool bindu se hatt jaate hain. Isliye sahi uttar Lack of centralized leadership, coordination, and modern resources hi hai. Exam point: Lack of centralized leadership, coordination, and modern resources - yah bindu yaad rakhne yogya hai.

qe: At which location was the rebel leader Tantia Tope executed by hanging?
qh: क्रांतिकारी नेता तात्या टोपे को किस स्थान पर फांसी दी गई थी?
e: Raja Man Singh ke betrayal ke baad Britishers ne Tantia Tope ko capture kiya aur 18 April 1859 ko Shivpuri (Madhya Pradesh) me phansi de di. Is prashn mein yah jaanna hai ki krantikari neta tatya tope ko kis sthan par phansi di gai thi? Isi karan se Shivpuri sahi uttar hai. Baaki vikalp - Gwalior, Jhansi, Kanpur - is vishay se mel nahi khaate. Yah vikalp anya sandarbh se aa jaate hain. Ant mein sahi chunav Shivpuri hi thehrta hai. Exam point: Shivpuri - is tathya ko aankdon ke saath yaad rakhein.

qe: Who spearheaded the leadership of the 1857 rebellion in Allahabad (Prayagraj)?
qh: इलाहाबाद (प्रयागराज) में 1857 के विद्रोह का नेतृत्व किसने किया था?
e: Maulvi Liaquat Ali ne Allahabad me rebellion organize kiya tha aur Khusro Bagh ko apna headquarters banaya tha jise baad me Colonel Neill ne capture kiya. Yah prashn is tathya se juda hai ki ilahabad (prayagaraj) mein 1857 ke vidroh ka netritv kisane kiya tha? Diye gaye tathya ke aadhar par Maulvi Liyakat Ali hi sahi baithta hai. Bakht Khan, Khan Bahadur Khan, Nana Saheb is baat ki sahi jaankari nahi dete. Yah teeno vikalp prashn ke mool bindu se hatt jaate hain. Isi wajah se Maulvi Liyakat Ali sahi hai. Exam point: Maulvi Liyakat Ali - yahi is prashn ki mukhya baat hai.

qe: On which date did the British army successfully recapture Delhi from rebel control?
qh: ब्रिटिश सेना ने दिल्ली पर पुनः अधिकार किस तिथि को किया था?
e: British forces ne John Nicholson aur Archdale Wilson ki command me lambe siege ke baad 20 September 1857 ko Delhi par wapas control kar liya tha. Is prashn mein poochha gaya hai ki british sena ne dilli par punah adhikar kis tithi ko kiya tha? Diye gaye tathya ke aadhar par 20th September 1857 hi sahi baithta hai. Galti 26th January 1858, 15th August 1857, 10th May 1858 chunne se hoti hai kyunki inka is tathya se talmel nahi hai. In vikalpon ka is prashn se seedha rishta nahi hai. Sabhi baaton ke baad 20th September 1857 hi theek uttar hai. Exam point: 20th September 1857 - isse jude tathya yaad rakhein.

qe: Which Nawab of Awadh was deposed by the British in 1856 on charges of maladministration?
qh: अवध के किस नवाब को 1856 में 'कुशासन' के आरोप में सत्ता से हटा दिया गया था?
e: 1856 me Lord Dalhousie ne James Outram ki report ke basis par Nawab Wajid Ali Shah par maladministration ka allegation lagakar Awadh annex kiya aur unhe Calcutta bhej diya. Prashn ka saar yah hai ki avadh ke kis navab ko 1856 mein 'kushasan' ke arop mein satta se hata diya gaya tha? Diye gaye tathya ke aadhar par Wajid Ali Shah sahi nikalta hai. Galti Siraj-ud-Daulah, Shuja-ud-Daula, Asaf-ud-Daula chunne se hoti hai kyunki inka is tathya se talmel nahi hai. Yah teeno vikalp prashn ke mool bindu se hatt jaate hain. Yahi sahi uttar Wajid Ali Shah hai. Exam point: Wajid Ali Shah - yahi is prashn ki mukhya baat hai.

qe: Who assumed the leadership of the 1857 uprising in Bareilly (Rohilkhand)?
qh: बरेली (रोहिलखंड) में 1857 के विद्रोह का नेतृत्व किसने किया था?
e: Bareilly me Rohilla lineage ke Khan Bahadur Khan ne British rule ke against uprising lead karke administrative control apne hath me liya tha. Is prashn ka mool sawaal yah hai ki bareli (rohilakhand) mein 1857 ke vidroh ka netritv kisane kiya tha? In tathyon ke chalte Khan Bahadur Khan hi sahi hai. General Bakht Khan, Kunwar Singh, Nana Saheb anya kaal, vyakti ya ghatna se jude hain. Isliye in vikalpon ko chhod dena chahiye. Is prashn ka theek jawab Khan Bahadur Khan hai. Exam point: Khan Bahadur Khan - is tathya ko aankdon ke saath yaad rakhein.

qe: Which British parliamentary act officially terminated East India Company rule in India?
qh: किस ब्रिटिश संसदीय अधिनियम द्वारा ईस्ट इंडिया कंपनी के शासन को समाप्त किया गया था?
e: Government of India Act 1858 ne East India Company ka rule abolish kar diya aur India ki direct governance British Crown aur Queen Victoria ke hath me de di. Is prashn mein mukhya baat yah hai ki kis british sansadiy adhiniyam dvara ist indiya kanpani ke shasan ko samapt kiya gaya tha? Isliye sahi nateeja Government of India Act 1858 nikalta hai. Pitt's India Act 1784, Regulating Act 1773, Charter Act 1813 mein is tathya ka sahi rang nahi milta. Inka is tathya se koi talmel nahi hai. Sabhi baaton ke baad Government of India Act 1858 hi theek uttar hai. Exam point: Government of India Act 1858 - yah baat pariksha mein baar-baar poochhi jaati hai.

qe: What was the name of Rani Lakshmibai's adopted son whose legal succession was rejected by Dalhousie?
qh: रानी लक्ष्मीबाई के दत्तक पुत्र का नाम क्या था जिसके उत्तराधिकार को डलहौजी ने खारिज कर दिया था?
e: Maharaja Gangadhar Rao ki death ke baad Rani Lakshmibai ne Anand Rao ko adopt kiya tha jiska naam Damodar Rao rakha gaya, par Dalhousie ne Doctrine of Lapse lagakar use manane se mana kar diya. Is prashn ka mool sawaal yah hai ki rani lakshmibai ke dattak putr ka nam kya tha jisake uttaradhikar ko dalahauji ne kharij kar diya tha? Isi karan se Damodar Rao sahi uttar hai. Gangadhar Rao, Baji Rao, Anand Rao anya kaal, vyakti ya ghatna se jude hain. Yah teeno vikalp prashn ke mool bindu se hatt jaate hain. Sabhi baaton ke baad Damodar Rao hi theek uttar hai. Exam point: Damodar Rao - yah baat pariksha mein baar-baar poochhi jaati hai.

qe: Who was the actual operational military commander of rebel forces in Delhi during the revolt?
qh: 1857 के विद्रोह के दौरान दिल्ली में विद्रोही सेना का वास्तविक सैन्य नेतृत्व किसने किया था?
e: Bareilly se aaye Subedar Bakht Khan ne Delhi me military command sambhali aur unhe Bahadur Shah Zafar ne 'Saheb-e-Alam Bahadur' ka title diya. Yahaan poochha gaya hai ki 1857 ke vidroh ke dauran dilli mein vidrohi sena ka vastavik sainy netritv kisane kiya tha? Isi baat se General Bakht Khan sahi sabit hota hai. Baaki vikalp - Nana Saheb, Tantia Tope, Bahadur Shah Zafar - is vishay se mel nahi khaate. In vikalpon ka is prashn se seedha rishta nahi hai. Yah sab dekhkar sahi uttar General Bakht Khan baithta hai. Exam point: General Bakht Khan - is tathya ko aankdon ke saath yaad rakhein.

qe: Which nationalist leader characterized the 1857 revolt as 'India's First War of Independence' in his 1909 book?
qh: किस राष्ट्रवादी नेता ने 1909 में अपनी पुस्तक में 1857 के विद्रोह को 'भारत का प्रथम स्वतंत्रता संग्राम' कहा था?
e: Vinayak Damodar Savarkar ne apni landmark book 'The Indian War of Independence 1857' me ise Britishers ki tarah mutiny na kehkar pehla swatantrata sangram bataya. Is prashn ka seedha matlab yah hai ki kis rashtravadi neta ne 1909 mein apani pustak mein 1857 ke vidroh ko 'bharat ka pratham svatantrata sangram' kaha tha? Isi karan se V.D. Savarkar sahi uttar hai. Jawaharlal Nehru, R.C. Majumdar, Subhas Chandra Bose in tathyon se hatt kar jaate hain. Yah teeno vikalp prashn ke mool bindu se hatt jaate hain. Yah sab dekhkar sahi uttar V.D. Savarkar baithta hai. Exam point: V.D. Savarkar - isse jude tathya yaad rakhein.

qe: What major military restructuring followed the 1857 revolt under the Peel Commission?
qh: 1857 के विद्रोह के बाद पील कमीशन के तहत ब्रिटिश सेना में कौन सा बड़ा बदलाव किया गया?
o: Complete dissolution of the standing army
Increased ratio of European soldiers and absolute European control over artillery
Transfer of heavy artillery to Indian regiments
e: Peel Commission ke mutabik European soldiers ka ratio badhaya gaya aur saara heavy artillery department strictly British troops ke haath me rakha gaya taaki mutiny repeat na ho. Prashn yah batata hai ki 1857 ke vidroh ke bad pil kamishan ke tahat british sena mein kaun sa bada badalav kiya gaya? Isliye sahi nateeja Increased ratio of European soldiers and absolute European control over artillery nikalta hai. Galti Complete dissolution of the standing army, Transfer of heavy artillery to Indian regiments, Total reduction of military personnel chunne se hoti hai kyunki inka is tathya se talmel nahi hai. Yah teeno vikalp prashn ke mool bindu se hatt jaate hain. Yahi sahi uttar Increased ratio of European soldiers and absolute European control over artillery hai. Exam point: Increased ratio of European soldiers and absolute European control over artillery - is tathya ko aankdon ke saath yaad rakhein.

qe: Who served as the Prime Minister of the United Kingdom during the 1857 Indian Revolt?
qh: 1857 के भारतीय विद्रोह के समय यूनाइटेड किंगडम के प्रधानमंत्री कौन थे?
e: 1857 revolt ke dauran Great Britain ke Prime Minister Lord Palmerston the, jinka tenure 1855 se 1858 tak tha. Yahaan poochha gaya hai ki 1857 ke bharatiy vidroh ke samay yunaited kingadam ke pradhanamantri kaun the? Isi aadhar par Lord Palmerston chuna jaata hai. Winston Churchill, William Gladstone, Clement Attlee in tathyon se hatt kar jaate hain. Isliye in vikalpon ko chhod dena chahiye. Isi wajah se Lord Palmerston sahi hai. Exam point: Lord Palmerston - yah baat pariksha mein baar-baar poochhi jaati hai.

qe: Who was appointed as the first Viceroy of India under the Act of 1858?
qh: 1858 के अधिनियम के तहत भारत के प्रथम वायसराय के रूप में किसे नियुक्त किया गया था?
e: 1 November 1858 ko Allahabad Darbar me Queen's proclamation padhne ke sath hi Lord Canning India ke last Governor-General aur first Viceroy bane. Yah prashn is tathya se juda hai ki 1858 ke adhiniyam ke tahat bharat ke pratham vayasaray ke rup mein kise niyukt kiya gaya tha? Diye gaye tathya ke aadhar par Lord Canning hi sahi baithta hai. Galti Lord Dalhousie, Lord Mountbatten, Lord Minto chunne se hoti hai kyunki inka is tathya se talmel nahi hai. Yah teeno vikalp prashn ke mool bindu se hatt jaate hain. Isliye sahi uttar Lord Canning hi hai. Exam point: Lord Canning - isse jude tathya yaad rakhein.

qe: Which was the first Indian state to enter into the Subsidiary Alliance system in 1798?
qh: 1798 में सहायक संधि प्रणाली स्वीकार करने वाली पहली भारतीय रियासत कौन सी थी?
e: Lord Wellesley ki Subsidiary Alliance treaty par sign karne wali sabse pehli Indian princely state Hyderabad (1798) ke Nizam the. Is prashn ka mool sawaal yah hai ki 1798 mein sahayak sandhi pranali svikar karane vali pahali bharatiy riyasat kaun si thi? Diye gaye tathya ke aadhar par Hyderabad hi sahi baithta hai. Vikalp Awadh, Maratha, Mysore bhi is tathya ke dayre se baahar hain. In vikalpon ka is prashn se seedha rishta nahi hai. Is prashn ka theek jawab Hyderabad hai. Exam point: Hyderabad - ise tathya ke saath yaad rakhein.

qe: Where was Rani Lakshmibai of Jhansi martyred while fighting British forces?
qh: झाँसी की रानी लक्ष्मीबाई ब्रिटिश सेना से लड़ते हुए कहाँ शहीद हुई थीं?
e: 18 June 1858 ko Gwalior ke paas Kota-ki-Sarai ke battle me Sir Hugh Rose ki forces ke against ladte hue Rani Lakshmibai veer-gati ko prapt hui thin. Yahaan poochha gaya hai ki jhansi ki rani lakshmibai british sena se ladate hue kahan shahid hui thin? Isliye sahi nateeja Gwalior nikalta hai. Vikalp Kanpur, Kalpi, Jhansi bhi is tathya ke dayre se baahar hain. Inka is tathya se koi talmel nahi hai. Sabhi baaton ke baad Gwalior hi theek uttar hai. Exam point: Gwalior - is tathya ko aankdon ke saath yaad rakhein.

qe: What was the birth name of the Maratha leader Tantia Tope?
qh: मराठा सेनानी तात्या टोपे का मूल नाम क्या था?
e: Nana Saheb ke trusted military commander Tantia Tope ka original real name Ramachandra Panduranga Yawalkar tha. Prashn yah batata hai ki maratha senani tatya tope ka mul nam kya tha? Isi tathya par Ramachandra Panduranga tika hua hai. Mahesh Das, Dhondu Pant, Bakht Singh ko chunne par jawab galat ho jaayega. Inka is tathya se koi talmel nahi hai. Aakhir mein sahi pehchan Ramachandra Panduranga hi milti hai. Exam point: Ramachandra Panduranga - is tathya ko aankdon ke saath yaad rakhein.

qe: On which date were Mangal Pandey and his execution ordered following the Barrackpore uprising?
qh: बैरकपुर विद्रोह के बाद मंगल पांडे को किस तिथि को फांसी दी गई थी?
e: 29 March 1857 ko revolt karne ke charge me trial chalne ke baad Mangal Pandey ko scheduled date se pehle 8 April 1857 ko Barrackpore me phansi de di gayi thi. Sawaal is baat ka hai ki bairakapur vidroh ke bad mangal pande ko kis tithi ko phansi di gai thi? Isi tathya par 8th April 1857 tika hua hai. 20th September 1857, 10th May 1857, 29th March 1857 alag khandan, kaal ya kshetra ke hain. Yah vikalp anya sandarbh se aa jaate hain. Sabhi baaton ke baad 8th April 1857 hi theek uttar hai. Exam point: 8th April 1857 - is tathya ko aankdon ke saath yaad rakhein.

qe: Who led the anti-British armed resistance in the Mandla (Ramgarh) region of Madhya Pradesh in 1857?
qh: 1857 में मध्य प्रदेश के मांडला (रामगढ़) क्षेत्र में ब्रिटिश विरोधी सशस्त्र प्रतिरोध का नेतृत्व किसने किया था?
e: Ramgarh (Mandla, MP) ki Rani Avantibai Lodhi ne 4,000 soldiers ki fauj organize karke Britishers ke against fierce resistance lead kiya tha. Prashn ka saar yah hai ki 1857 mein madhy pradesh ke mandala (ramagadh) kshetr mein british virodhi sashastr pratirodh ka netritv kisane kiya tha? Isi tathya par Rani Avantibai Lodhi tika hua hai. Begum Hazrat Mahal, Rani Lakshmibai, Jhalkaribai ko chunne par jawab galat ho jaayega. Yah teeno vikalp prashn ke mool bindu se hatt jaate hain. Ant mein sahi chunav Rani Avantibai Lodhi hi thehrta hai. Exam point: Rani Avantibai Lodhi - ise tathya ke saath yaad rakhein.

qe: In which year did the exiled last Mughal Emperor Bahadur Shah Zafar pass away in Rangoon?
qh: रंगून में निर्वासित अंतिम मुगल सम्राट बहादुर शाह जफर की मृत्यु किस वर्ष हुई थी?
e: Bahadur Shah Zafar ki death 7 November 1862 ko Rangoon (ab Yangon, Myanmar) me exile ke dauran British custody me hui thi. Yahaan poochha gaya hai ki rangun mein nirvasit antim mugal samrat bahadur shah japhar ki mrityu kis varsh hui thi? Isi baat se 1862 sahi sabit hota hai. 1857, 1865, 1858 in tathyon se hatt kar jaate hain. Isliye in vikalpon ko chhod dena chahiye. Isi wajah se 1862 sahi hai. Exam point: 1862 - isse jude tathya yaad rakhein.

qe: What is the precise definition of the term 'Mutiny' in military terminology?
qh: सैन्य शब्दावली में 'म्यूटिनी' (सैन्य विद्रोह) शब्द का सटीक अर्थ क्या है?
o: Collective defiance and refusal to obey lawful orders of superior military officers
e: Jab armed forces ke soldiers collective level par aapas me milkar apne commanding officers ke lawful orders maanne se inkar karte hain aur authority ke against bagawat karte hain, toh use Mutiny kehte hain. Is prashn mein yah jaanna hai ki sainy shabdavali mein 'myutini' (sainy vidroh) shabd ka satik arth kya hai? Diye gaye tathya ke aadhar par Collective defiance and refusal to obey lawful orders of superior military officers hi sahi baithta hai. Commercial trading dispute between merchants, General strike by civilian farmers, Formal diplomatic peace negotiations mein is tathya ka sahi rang nahi milta. Yah vikalp anya sandarbh se aa jaate hain. Sabhi baaton ke baad Collective defiance and refusal to obey lawful... hi theek uttar hai. Exam point: Collective defiance and refusal to obey lawful... - isse jude tathya yaad rakhein.
